cases.expected: ManagedNativeHost.admit composes with the real gateway signature and registry. A stopped or missing registered native process cannot perform a later worker effect.
Failure of an SDK/session disconnect still attempts complete owned process-group stop and records actual stop evidence; private cleanup does not depend on a successful protocol close.
The worker run_command route accepts only its registered confined or protected-merge commands. A full-assignment model invocation cannot be invoked recursively as a worker command.
Codex client replies must match an outstanding exact request identity. Foreign, future, stale or duplicated replies never satisfy a later request.
